verdict.rationale: Spline's docs describe 3D scene design, AI-generated screens/textures, code export, and MCP integration, but none mention core vector-editing tools like pen/path editing, boolean operations, or precise alignment guides expected for interface design work. Since Spline explicitly supports 2D/UI screen design (docs-21, docs-34), this axis is a fair question, but there is no evidence it delivers these professional vector tools.
